details:
NAKSH is an interactive web platform that helps users identify Earth environments analogous to potential permanent Moon and Mars base locations. Users can explore lunar and Martian targets in a 3D interface, search Earth locations, compare environmental characteristics, and view target-specific Analog Compatibility Index rankings.

The platform evaluates terrain, environmental conditions, and geology-related indicators using structured datasets and transparent scoring. Rankings change according to the selected planetary target and weighting criteria. This helps users understand why locations such as deserts, polar regions, volcanic areas, and high-altitude environments may be useful analogs for future exploration research and astronaut field testing.

NAKSH was developed using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSON datasets, Python data-processing scripts, GitHub, and Vercel deployment. The project is designed for students, researchers, educators, mission planners, and the public. Its interactive 3D visualizations and searchable data make planetary science easier to understand and support early-stage site comparison for future human exploration.
